calmInstruction: Use the attached painting ONLY as a style reference: copy its oil-paint brushwork, single warm key light from the upper left, deep chiaroscuro shadow, muted palette, plain dark smoky background, head-and-shoulders framing and three-quarter pose. Do NOT copy the person in it. Paint a completely NEW, different person, described below, as the next portrait in the same series.
style: painted noir portrait, oil painting with visible brushwork, 1950s, dramatic chiaroscuro single warm key light from upper left, deep shadows, muted desaturated palette of umber, slate blue and ochre, plain dark smoky painted background with soft gradient, absolutely no writing, no letters, no symbols, no objects in the background, head-and-shoulders bust, facing three-quarter toward viewer, cinematic, fine art, original character, not a real person, no text, no watermark, hands not visible, consistent portrait series
moodInstruction: Keep exactly the same person, face, hair, clothing, framing, background, lighting and painting style. Natural skin tone, no added redness. Change only the facial expression to:

moods.evasive: evasive and guarded: eyes glancing away to the side, lips pressed into a tight polite half-smile, chin slightly lowered, as if hiding something
moods.angry: angry: brows drawn hard together, eyes narrowed and glaring at the viewer, jaw clenched, nostrils slightly flared
moods.cracked: cracked and distressed: brows raised and pinched in the middle, eyes glistening close to tears, mouth slightly open, the composure gone
